verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Auto Loader with Lakeflow pipelines to incrementally process new files as they arrive in cloud storage, plus managed ingestion connectors as a lower-customization alternative to hand-built Spark/SQL pipelines. Real-time mode is also documented to process records as they arrive. A community user notes the platform saves time otherwise spent configuring pipelines and compute. missing for 10: explicit evidence that ingestion runs on fully managed/serverless compute with no cluster management, documented event-stream sources (e.g., message queues) for managed ingestion, and hands-on corroboration of continuous file/event ingestion specifically.
